data.title: Fuel Delivery
data.description: Muscles need food for energy. Build the path food takes from the mouth to a working muscle.

challenges.name: person
challenges.intro: A person lives in a home and runs around to play outside.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets the person's food to its leg muscle.
challenges.principle: Food gets broken down and passes into the blood. Then the blood carries the food to working muscles.

jobs.mouth: The mouth chews and swallows the food.
jobs.stomach: The stomach mashes the swallowed food into liquid.
jobs.intestines: The intestines soak up the mashed food into the blood.
jobs.heart: The heart pumps the blood carrying the food.
jobs.blood_tubes: The blood tubes deliver the food straight to working muscles.

challenges.name: bird
challenges.intro: A bird flies through the open sky and rests in tall trees.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets the bird's food to its wing muscle.
challenges.principle: Food is crushed inside and moves into the blood. Then the blood carries the food out to working muscles.

jobs.mouth: The mouth swallows the food down.
jobs.crop: The crop stores the swallowed food to soften it.
jobs.gizzard: The gizzard grinds the swallowed food into mash.
jobs.intestines: The intestines take up the mashed food into the blood.
jobs.heart: The heart pumps the blood filled with food.
jobs.blood_tubes: The blood tubes carry the food right to working muscles.

challenges.name: cow
challenges.intro: A cow lives on a wide farm and walks across sunny pastures.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets the cow's food to its leg muscle.
challenges.principle: Food is mashed up and enters the blood. Then the blood carries the food to working muscles.

jobs.mouth: The mouth takes in food and swallows it.
jobs.four_stomach: The four-part stomach breaks down and mashes the swallowed food.
jobs.intestines: The intestines absorb the mashed food into the blood.
jobs.heart: The heart pumps the blood with food across the body.
jobs.blood_tubes: The blood tubes guide the food to working muscles.
